title: OA CLIMATE GROUPINGS - the seven climate groupings with the game creatures and the Creatures from Previous Books cross-reference
audit_comment: OA round ninety-one (capture pp. 252-253): the Climate Groupings with Creatures from Previous Books - the seven climate groupings, the game creature lists, the doctrine, and the earlier-books cross-reference, single-pass pins per the Chapter 9 provenance shift

banner.title: OA CLIMATE GROUPINGS, printed capture pp. 252-253 - the climate doctrine and cross-reference round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture - the sole surviving pass per the R679 provenance shift. THE SEVEN GROUPINGS: the Sub-Arctic Forests (the 18 creatures - bear, carp, deer through tiger, wolf, wolverine); the Temperate Plain/Forest (the 20 - badger through wolverine); the Steppelands (the 13 - the Bactrian camel through wolf); the Sub-Tropical Forest (the 18 - alligator through wolf); the Tropical Forest (the 18 - badger through wild boar); the Cold Oceans (the 6 - cod through seal); the Warm Oceans (the 4 - dolphin through shark); the 61 distinct creatures across the seven. THE DOCTRINE: the creatures unique to Kara-Tur; the common creatures held at bay by stormy oceans, grim mountain ranges, and scalding deserts; the grouping by geography and climate; the common and game creatures off the encounter tables. THE CROSS-REFERENCE: the Creatures from Previous Books - 124 entries alphabetical, the MMI 59, the FF 18, the MMII 46, the LL 1; the list aids the DM and is not exclusive - the listed are those most likely to fit the mythos. THE CELESTIAL BUREAUCRACY: the Celestial Emperor heads the government of the spirits; the officials can be corrupt, disobedient, just, or incompetent, replaced after the yearly examination of their activities. The prose codifies per the R431 calculus
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 157 closed, 78 open - the Climate Groupings box flips (census 626 -> 627); NEXT - R705: the Chapter 12 monster roster opener - the Bajang (capture pp. 253-254), prefix djs (verify free at the landing), audit "R705 OA monsters Bajang audit", include after rules/oa75climate.h
